title: XW-ENC-AFFINITY-1 (apex-mf6) L2b live: pinned-mint x untagged-target = STRIP at switch (the mismatch arm, live). Fresh ACP session on gpt-5.6-sol (live row pinned, expected tag 'East US 2' — the live probe in the wave settles whether the live config still pins sol; an untagged sol row makes the D1 mint stamp None and is a REPORT finding, not a case edit). Two sol turns (O7 M-1: reasoning-forcing modular-exponentiation prompts at the strongest expressible effort 'max' — via the case's global [models] default_reasoning_effort config_patch, since the session wire effort resolves from the manager current (seeded from that global) projected onto the row menu, not from a row-level scalar; the original trivial echoes minted no rides, which made the zero-ciphertext pin VACUOUS and the reasoning-summary pin unsatisfiable, wave 20260920T072948Z; the terra-row tag-emptying patch below is UNTOUCHED): each response's reasoning item is mint-stamped (D1) with the sol row's pin, so by switch time every ride in the store carries mint_tag=Some(sol-pin). The case config_patch empties the TERRA row's x-litellm-tags, then a BARE switch op (session/set_model, no cell: the runner's switch_model op requires a cell whose storage golden is scored at switch time — a cell cannot pin runtime-generated pre-switch turns, so the mismatch switch is driven by the cell-less `switch` op and pinned on the wire only), then one post-switch turn. PREDICTED (design 3.2/3.4 + in-tree gate): switch-time projection target_pin=None, every ride mint_tag=Some(EU2) -> (None, Some) = STRIP -> the store loses ALL ciphertext at switch time; the first (and only) post-switch terra request therefore carries ZERO encrypted_content, the stripped rides still cross with their summary text (the strip removes only the field), the terra request is 200 on attempt 1 (nothing to trigger a boundary 503). ANY terra request carrying encrypted_content = gate misclassification of the (None,Some) arm (or an untagged sol row -> mint None -> RetainOptimistic — the live-probe disambiguation) -> report-and-stop. Suite is cross-wire (the committed schema has no enc-affinity suite; the affinity semantics live in the pins).

wire.label: L2b MISMATCH STRIP (the core pin): NO terra request carries encrypted_content — every ride was mint-stamped under the pinned sol row and the switch-time gate (target pin None x mint Some) = STRIP, so the untagged terra request is ciphertext-free by construction. This pin doubles as the zero-503 detector: any ciphertext reaching the untagged row is exactly the boundary-503 trigger, so ciphertext-present and 503 are the same defect surface. Present = gate misclassification of the (None,Some) arm (or untagged-sol-row premise failure -> the wave's live probe disambiguates; either way report-and-stop, never a case edit).

POST-SWITCH REASONING SUMMARY PRESENT: the stripped rides still cross the terra wire as reasoning items carrying their summary text (the mf6 strip removes ONLY the encrypted_content field; id/summary handling is unchanged). Absent = over-strip (summary loss) or the post-switch turn never replayed history -> report-and-stop.

NO STORM: 1 = the clean path (no ciphertext ever reached the wire, 200 on attempt 1 — the expected outcome); 2 = the fallback arm fired once (which would ALSO red the ciphertext-absent pin — the band exists so the retry is recorded, not masked). >=3 = fallback loop (counter is max-1/request by construction) -> report-and-stop; 0 = the post-switch turn never fired -> report-and-stop.
FINAL ACCEPTED: the FINAL terra request reached 200. A non-200 final = brick / unclassified wire-error shape -> report-and-stop.
